claims.statement: Alarm lot LOT-1239 measured 520.6 outside spec 485.0 to 515.0
CLN02 mean 511.33 versus CLN01 mean 501.56 with p-value 0.0211, while DEP p-value 0.5493 and MET p-value 0.7916 show no chamber or metrology split

LOT-1230 at 69.3 measured 520.69 on DEP02-B and LOT-1232 at 69.9 measured 519.9 on DEP01-B and LOT-1235 at 70.8 measured 520.65 on DEP02-B and LOT-1239 at 72.0 measured 520.6 on DEP02-A were all CLN02, while LOT-1229 at 69.0 measured 501.74 on DEP02-A and LOT-1233 at 70.2 measured 500.56 on DEP02-B were CLN01

disposition.summary: Thick film appears only on lots from CLN02 across multiple deposition chambers and both metrology tools, starting after normal CLN02 lots. The alarm chamber DEP02-A ran a normal CLN01 lot after its PM, so the chamber itself is fine. Hold the alarm lot and escalate the clean tool.

truth.explanation: CLN02 started leaving the surface in a state that deposits thick in the center, on every chamber.

public: US Patent 8,718,809, Comprehensive analysis of queue times in microelectronic manufacturing
Film growth can be influenced by the pre-clean to deposition queue time.
Chien, Wang, Cheng (2007), Data mining for yield enhancement in semiconductor manufacturing, Expert Systems with Applications 33(1)
Statistical tests over process history point to the tools behind an excursion, the idea behind commonality analysis.
sources.practitioner: Equipment or upstream problems are suspected when abnormal lots cluster in one group. One contact called upstream and shared-facility effects very frequent; the other thought them rare. We keep the scenario and note the disagreement.
